payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_each_attempt_line_names_its_new_failures_beneath_its_count stayed green with the spec's wrong version '`describe` sorts the failures before printing them.' applied to saffron/events.py as an edit. The claim was "Each counted `Attempt` carries `failures`, every new failure of its suite rendered by `baseline.render`, in `comparison.new_failures` order. That holds on the GATE line for each of the decisions `green`, `repair`, `no-progress` and `exhausted`, and on the REBUT line. `describe` prints each one beneath the count line, on its own line, after two spaces. Each control character in it becomes a space, the strip `_clean` applies, and nothing clips it, past 500 characters included. The green line prints nothing beneath. An aborted or drifted suite's line carries an empty tuple and prints one line.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_session.py::test_a_red_rebuttal_line_names_each_gate_that_failed_anew, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
